values.name: Place of terms of delivery
values.description: (3018) Point or port of departure, shipment or destination, as required under the applicable terms of delivery, e.g. Incoterms.

values.name: Payment place
values.description: Place where funds are to be, or have been made available to the creditor.

values.name: Goods receipt place
values.description: Place at which the goods have been received by the consignee.

values.name: Place of departure
values.description: (3214) Port, airport or other location from which a means of transport is scheduled to depart or has departed.

values.name: Place of delivery
values.description: (3246) Place to which the goods are to be finally delivered under transport contract terms (operational term).

values.name: Place of destination
values.description: Port, airport or other location to which a means of transport is destined.

values.name: Place/port of loading
values.description: (3334 + 3230) Seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other place at which the goods (cargo) are loaded on to the means of transport being used for their carriage.

values.name: Place of acceptance
values.description: (3348) Place at which the goods are taken over by the carrier.

values.name: Place/port of discharge
values.description: (3392 + 3414) Seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other place at which the goods (cargo) are unloaded from the means of transport having been used for their carriage.

values.name: Port of discharge
values.description: Port at which the goods are discharged from the vessel used for their transport.

values.name: Place of transhipment
values.description: (3424) Place where goods are transferred from one means of transport to another (operational term).

values.name: Location of goods
values.description: (3384) Place where goods are located and where they are available for examination.

values.name: Place of transfer responsibility
values.description: Place where the responsibility for the goods under transport is transferred.

values.name: Place of transfer of ownership
values.description: Place where the ownership of the goods is transferred.

values.name: Border crossing place
values.description: Place where goods are transported across a country border.

values.name: Warehouse
values.description: (3156) Warehouse where a particular consignment has been stored.

values.name: Factory/plant
values.description: Factory/plant relevant for a particular consignment.

values.name: Place of ultimate destination of goods
values.description: Place where goods will ultimately be delivered.

values.name: Terms of sale place
values.description: Place of departure, shipment or destination as specified in the terms of sale agreed between the parties.

values.name: Customs office of clearance
values.description: (3080) Place where Customs clearance procedure occur (CCC).

values.name: Port of release
values.description: Port where goods are released from Customs custody.

values.name: Port of entry
values.description: Port where final documentation is filed for Customs Entry processing.

values.name: Country
values.description: Country relevant for a particular transaction.

values.name: City
values.description: City or town relevant for a particular transaction or consignment.

values.name: Country of origin
values.description: [3238] Country in which the goods have been produced or manufactured, according to criteria laid down for the purposes of application of the Customs tariff, of quantitative restrictions, or of any other measure related to trade.

values.name: Country of destination of goods
values.description: Country to which the goods are to be delivered.

values.name: Railway station
values.description: Name or identification of a railway station/yard relevant to a particular consignment.

values.name: Country of source
values.description: Country in which raw material or components were originally produced prior to manufacture or assembly in another country.

values.name: Building
values.description: A building or part thereof relevant to a particular consignment or transaction.

values.name: Beginning of chargeable section
values.description: First rail station in a predefined section of the chargeable voyage. A complete voyage may be divided in sections, even within one country, that are separately chargeable using different tariff rules (split tariffs).

values.name: Baseport of discharge
values.description: The port of discharge according to the tariff as opposed to the operational port of discharge. The goods may or may not be actually discharged at that port on the main transport.

values.name: Baseport of loading
values.description: The port of loading according to the tariff as opposed to the operational port of loading. The goods may or may not be actually loaded at that port on the main transport.

values.name: Country of exportation/despatch
values.description: (3220) Country from which the goods were initially exported to the importing country without any commercial transaction taking place in intermediate countries. Syn.: country whence consigned. Country of despatch: country from which goods are despatched between countries of a Customs union.

values.name: Country of ultimate destination
values.description: (3216) Country known to the consignor or his agent at the time of despatch to be the final country to which the goods are to be delivered.

values.name: Country of last consignment
values.description: [3331] Country where the goods are loaded onto the means of transport used for their importation.

values.name: Country of first destination
values.description: [3219] Country where the goods are offloaded from the means of transport used for their exportation.

values.name: Country of production
values.description: Country where item has been or will be produced.

values.name: Country of trading
values.description: Country where item has been or will be traded.

values.name: Customs office of entry
values.description: [3088] Customs office at which the goods enter the country of destination.

values.name: Customs office of exit
values.description: [3096] Customs office at which the goods leave the country of dispatch/export.

values.name: Place of Customs examination
values.description: Place where Customs undertakes a physical inspection of goods to satisfy themselves that the goods' nature, origin, condition, quantity and value are in accordance with the particulars furnished on the goods declaration (CCC).

values.name: Place of authentication of document
values.description: (3410) Place where document is signed or otherwise authenticated. Synonym: Place of issue of document.

values.name: Customs office of destination (transit)
values.description: (3086) Customs office at which a transit operation is terminated. Synonym: Customs office of transit termination.

values.name: Region of despatch
values.description: Region from which goods are despatched between countries of a Customs union.

values.name: Region of destination
values.description: Region known to the consignor or his agent at the time of despatch to be the final region to which the goods are to be delivered.

values.name: Region of production
values.description: Region where item has been or will be produced.

values.name: Country of transit
values.description: Country through which goods transit.

values.name: Customs office of transit
values.description: [3106] Customs office which is competent for transit formalities en route.

values.name: Country of invalid transit guarantee
values.description: Country in which the security or guarantee for the movement of goods under a transit procedure is not valid.

values.name: Country of destination (transit)
values.description: Country at which a Customs transit operation is terminated. Synonym: Country of transit termination.

values.name: Charge and freight due from
values.description: Place or point from which charges and freight are charged.

values.name: Manufacturing department
values.description: A department within the manufacturing area (e.g. lacquering, assembly).

values.name: Charges and freight payable to
values.description: [3274] Name of place up to which freight charges and other charges are to be paid.

values.name: End of chargeable section
values.description: Last rail station in a predefined section of the chargeable voyage. A complete voyage may be divided in sections, even within one country, that are separately chargeable using different tariff rules (split tariffs).

values.name: Place of payment
values.description: Name of the location at which freight and charges for main transport are payable.

values.name: Full track loading or unloading
values.description: Identification of the station proceeding to the loading or unloading of a rail wagon on a full track site. (Used only when a rail station is obliged to transfer the load on another wagon for technical reasons - e.g. damage).

values.name: Place of arrival
values.description: Place at which the transport means arrives.

values.name: Next port of call
values.description: Next port which the vessel is going to call upon.

values.name: On-carriage port
values.description: Port of discharge at which the cargo is discharged from the vessel, used for transport after the main transport (transit port).

values.name: First optional place of discharge
values.description: The first optional place or port of discharge as mentioned on the transport document where cargo can be discharged at the option of the shipper.

values.name: Express railway station
values.description: Railway station offering express transportation services.

values.name: Mixed cargo railway station
values.description: Railway station offering mixed cargo transportation services .

values.name: Second optional place of discharge
values.description: The second optional place or port of discharge as mentioned on the transport document where cargo can be discharged at the option of shipper.

values.name: Next non-discharge port of call
values.description: A code to identify the next port of call for a vessel where no cargo will be discharged.

values.name: Third optional place of discharge
values.description: The third optional place or port of discharge as mentioned on the transport document where cargo can be discharged at the option of the shipper.

values.name: Reconsolidation point
values.description: A place where cargo is reconsolidated.

values.name: Fourth optional place of discharge
values.description: The fourth optional place or port of discharge as mentioned on the transport document where cargo can be discharged at the option of the shipper.

values.name: Bill of lading release office
values.description: A location where bills of lading are released to customers.

values.name: Transhipment excluding this place
values.description: Place/location where a transhipment from a means of transport to another means of transport is not authorised.

values.name: Transhipment limited to this place
values.description: Only place/location where a transhipment from a means of transport to another means of transport is authorised.

values.name: Original port of loading
values.description: The port where the goods were first loaded on a vessel.

values.name: First port of call - non-discharging
values.description: Port in the country of destination where the conveyance initially arrives from the 'last place/port of call of conveyance' and where a conveyance will not be discharging cargoes.

values.name: First port of call - discharging
values.description: Port in the country of destination where the conveyance initially arrives from the 'last place/port of call of conveyance' and where a conveyance will be discharging cargoes.

values.name: Place/port of first entry
values.description: Place or port where final documentation is filed for Customs Entry processing.

values.name: Place of despatch
values.description: Place at which the goods are taken over for carriage (operational term), if different from the transport contract place of acceptance (see: 10). Synonym: Place of origin of carriage.

values.name: Fifth optional place of discharge
values.description: The fifth optional place or port of discharge as mentioned on the transport document where cargo can be discharged at the option of the shipper.

values.name: Pre-carriage port
values.description: Port of loading at which the cargo is loaded on the pre- carriage vessel used for the transport prior to the main transport.

values.name: Place of delivery (by on carriage)
values.description: Place to which the goods are to be finally delivered.

values.name: Transport contract place of acceptance
values.description: Place at which the goods are taken over by the carrier according to the contract of carriage.

values.name: Transport contract place of destination
values.description: Place to which the goods are destined.

values.name: Country of valid transit guarantee
values.description: Country in which the security or guarantee for the movement of goods under a transit procedure is valid.

values.name: Place/port of conveyance initial arrival
values.description: Place/port in the country of destination where the conveyance initially arrives from the "Last place/port of call of conveyance" (125).

values.name: Place of receipt
values.description: Identification of the location at which the cargo is actually received.

values.name: Place of registration
values.description: Place where a means of transport is officially registered.

values.name: Place/location where special treatments have happened or must happen
Place of document issue
values.description: The place or location where a document is issued.

values.name: Routing
values.description: Indication of a routing place.

values.name: Station of application of additional costs
values.description: Rail station where, according to the transport contract, some chargeable operations must happen (re-weighting, re- fixing of the load, control on equipment and on consignment, etc.).

values.name: Place of lodgement of documents
values.description: Customs station where, required documents for Customs declarations, have been lodged.

values.name: Optional place of discharge
values.description: The optional place or port of discharge as mentioned on the bill of lading where cargo is discharged at the option of the shipper.

values.name: Place of empty equipment despatch
values.description: The location from which empty equipment is despatched.

values.name: Place of empty equipment return
values.description: The location to which empty equipment is returned.

values.name: Place/port of warehouse entry
values.description: Location (e.g. district) within a Customs territory where a warehouse entry was filed to enter merchandise into a Customs bonded warehouse.

values.name: Country of first sale
values.description: Name of country where firstly a sale took place.

values.name: Country of purchase
values.description: [3394] Country where the importer's co-contractor is domiciled or has his business.

values.name: Place of transfer
values.description: Place at which goods are transferred from one carrier to another (contractual term).

values.name: Place of deconsolidation
values.description: Place where a large consignment is de-grouped into smaller consignments.

values.name: Place of consumption
values.description: Place/location where goods enter the marketplace (commerce) of the importing country.

values.name: Region of origin
values.description: Region in which the goods have been produced or manufactured according to the criteria laid down for the purposes of the application of the Customs tariff, of quantitative restrictions or of any other measures related to trade (see: 3238).

values.name: Place of consolidation
values.description: Place where smaller consignments of goods are grouped together into a large consignment to be transported as a larger unit.

values.name: Rate combination point
values.description: Point over which sector rates are combined.

values.name: Place of prolongation decision of delivery delay
values.description: Place where it has been decided to prolong the delivery delay.

values.name: Recharging place/location
values.description: Place/location where a consignment has been changed of destination and is subject to a recharge note. (Complementary orders to modify the routing of the transport may be given, upon which a new charge calculation may be applied by the carrier).

values.name: Customs office of despatch
values.description: Customs office from which goods are despatched between countries of a Customs union.

values.name: Country of despatch
values.description: Country from which goods are despatched within a Customs union.

values.name: Customs office of export
values.description: Customs office from which goods are taken out of the Customs territory (CCC).

values.name: Free zone of export
values.description: Foreign free zone (desc: see 1131 = 131) from which goods are exported to the country of importation.

values.name: Region of export/despatch
values.description: Region from which the goods were initially exported to the importing country without any commercial transaction taking place in intermediate countries. Region of despatch: region from which goods are despatched between countries of a Customs union.

values.name: Customs office of departure
values.description: Customs office at which a Customs transit operation commences (CCC).

values.name: Customs office of transit guarantee
values.description: [3110] Customs office at which a security or guarantee for the movement of goods under a transit procedure is lodged.

values.name: Country of transhipment
values.description: Country where goods are transferred under Customs control from the importing means of transport to the exporting means of transport within the area of one Customs office which is the office of both importation and exportation (CCC).

values.name: Country of sale
values.description: [3116] Country where exporter's co-contractor is domiciled or has his business.

values.name: Customs office of destination
values.description: Customs office where the goods are to be cleared (CCC).

values.name: Wagon-load railway station
values.description: Self explanatory (railway environment).

values.name: Last place/port of call of conveyance
values.description: Conveyance departed from this last foreign place/port of call to go to "Place/port of conveyance initial arrival" (87).

values.name: Country of previous Customs procedure
values.description: Country in which the Customs declaration for the previous Customs procedure has been lodged.

values.name: Customs office of registration of previous Customs declaration
values.description: Customs office where the previous Customs declaration has been lodged.

values.name: Participant sender location
values.description: Place where a participant in the movement of goods is located and can be contacted.

values.name: Wage negotiation district
values.description: The district to which workers belong for the purposes of union wage negotiation.

values.name: Place of ultimate destination of conveyance
values.description: Seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other place to which a means of transport is ultimately destined.

values.name: Place of loading of empty equipment
values.description: Seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other place where empty equipment (e.g. containers) was loaded onto means of transport.

values.name: Place of discharge of empty equipment
values.description: Seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other place where empty equipment (e.g. containers) was unloaded from means of transport.

values.name: Region of delivery
values.description: (3246) Region to which the goods are to be finally delivered under transport contract terms (operational term).

values.name: Petroleum warehouse
values.description: Bonded petroleum warehouse or the supplier source.

values.name: Place of entry (Customs)
values.description: Place at which the goods enter the Customs territory.

values.name: Living animals care place
values.description: Place where living animal cares are provided.

values.name: Re-icing place
values.description: Place where re-icing must be executed.

values.name: Weighting place
values.description: Place where weight can be ascertained.

values.name: Marshalling yard
values.description: Station where the wagons are disconnected and reconnected to form a new train.

values.name: Shopping station
values.description: Station where the train must stop or is stopped for unexpected handling.

values.name: Loading dock
values.description: Platform specially equipped for loading and unloading of rail wagons.

values.name: Port connection
values.description: Track connecting a rail station to a dock.

values.name: Place of expiry
values.description: Place where the documentary credit expires for presentation of required documents.

values.name: Place of negotiation
values.description: Place where the documentary credit is to be presented for negotiation.

values.name: Claims payable place
values.description: Place where insurance claims are payable.

values.name: Documentary credit available in
values.description: Place where the documentary credit is available with any bank.

values.name: Stowage cell
values.description: Location on a vessel where units can be stowed.

values.name: For transportation to
values.description: Place/country where goods are to be transported to.

values.name: Loading on board/despatch/taking in charge at/from
values.description: Place/country where goods have to be loaded on board, despatched or taken in charge.

values.name: Private box
values.description: A private box used for pick-up and delivery of packages, e.g. of express packages.

values.name: Next port of discharge
values.description: Next port at which goods are discharged from the vessel used for their transport.

values.name: Port of call
values.description: Port where a vessel has called upon or will call upon.

values.name: Place/location of on-hire
values.description: Place/location where an object is contracted for use.

values.name: Place/location of off-hire
values.description: Place/location where an object's contract for use ends.

values.name: Other carriers terminal
values.description: A carrier terminal belonging to a carrier other than the original carrier.

values.name: Country of Value Added Tax (VAT) jurisdiction
values.description: The country governing the VAT regulation to which the transaction is subject.

values.name: Contact location
values.description: The site where a contact is located.

values.name: Additional internal destination
values.description: Any location within the consignee's premises where the goods are moved to.

values.name: Foreign port of call
values.description: A code to identify the foreign port where the vessel calls at or will call at.

values.name: Maintenance location
values.description: A location where maintenance has been or will be performed.

values.name: Place or location of sale
values.description: Place or location at which the sale takes place.

values.name: Direct investment country
values.description: Country in which a direct investment is made or withdrawn.

values.name: Berth
values.description: Place or location in a port where a vessel is moored.

values.name: Construction country
values.description: Country in which the construction work is made.

values.name: Donation acting country
values.description: Country acting in the donation of aid.

values.name: Payment transaction country
values.description: Country of the foreign counterpart of the payment transaction.

values.name: Physical place of return of item
values.description: Physical place at which the item is returned, i.e. the location where the supplier receives the item form the customer.

values.name: Mutually defined
values.description: Place or location as agreed between the relevant parties.
